Legacy campaign

A Different Kind of Growth (2042–2061)

Your last twenty years come with one carbon budget. Every tonne your California utility emits in 2042 counts toward the same total as a tonne in 2061.

Open the Legacy campaign↗ Your decisions ↓

Play the chapters in order. You carry the same utility from one generation to the next.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
2042
Generation
20 years

Your starting point

Eight generations have handed this company on. In 2042 you take over their fleet and finances for the ninth and final term.

Electricity demand keeps growing. An early cut in emissions gives you more room in the budget for years when you need extra generation.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Choose which emissions to cut first

    Look at which plants run most often. Bringing a cleaner replacement online early saves emissions for more of the term.

  2. 02

    Look at the whole day's demand

    Compare building capacity with helping customers use less. Check whether the resulting fleet can still cover the hours after sunset.

  3. 03

    Keep the company running through 2061

    Track bills and debt alongside the carbon total. Customers still need reliable power throughout your final term.

Can you take the utility that started with one coal plant all the way to 2061?
